english:
I thank Jesus and Mother Mary a lot. This is my second testimony. I am very thankful to Kreupasanam Mother to make me stand at this altar to share this.
My name is Jino. I am from Mavelikkara. I took the pilgrimage Covenant on December 30.
I have been in the Covenant since 2019 — moving forward by taking both the pilgrimage Covenant and the online Covenant here.
Now what I am going to share is the testimony about my sister getting a baby. She got a baby after 13 years.
They suffered a lot. They took many treatments — and nothing worked. For 13 years they chased after this.
My sister’s husband left all his work because they wanted a baby — they wanted a second child.
For that, he quit his job, left everything, and came back home. They took many treatments — nothing happened.
I told them — come and pray at Kreupasanam. At that time I was still in the Covenant. They were not willing to accept this. They said — “Okay, we are praying,
we go to our church, nothing wrong with that.” I said — “At least once, come and see. Listen to what I am telling you.” They just said “Okay, okay,” and ignored it.
Then I told my sister Sijo — “I have a little Covenant oil. Let me apply it on your stomach.”
I gave a little into her hand. I applied it on her hand and also applied on her stomach.
I applied the oil and told her, “Now you pray sincerely.” She said, “Okay, I will pray.” Usually whenever they did a pregnancy test, it was always negative.
Then I told her, “Pray sincerely.” And I told Mother, “Mother, this is my own sister. Make her a great testimony that glorifies you.” I prayed, crying before Mother.
After that, they went to the hospital to take a test. On the way, they saw a Kreupasanam leaflet kept in a church.
Both her husband and she got down, took that leaflet, and prayed. Then they continued to the hospital to take the test — and it came positive!
She called me and told me. I said, “See! It’s Mother’s hand! Mother will hold you through that leaflet. Don’t worry.” After that,
they came into great faith — because for 13 years, even after so many treatments, there was no baby. Through Mother’s leaflet — just as Father says —
it was Mother’s hand that touched her womb and the baby was given. And this is that child — now 11 months old.
When she became pregnant, she had many issues — BP, sugar — all were problems and she was bedridden.
While scanning the baby, the doctor said a cervical suture must be done.
She called me — because whatever problem came, she would call me — since I had taken a Covenant for her. She told me, “Sister, I’m going for scanning. Pray for me.” I told her,
“You don’t worry about anything. I am talking to the biggest gynecologist in the world. So you don’t be afraid.” Then she went and did the scan.
After scanning, the doctor said the cervical suture must be done tomorrow itself.
She called me and told me, “Sister, please pray well. I don’t want to do that procedure.” I told her, “Don’t worry about anything. You won’t have to do it.”
One doctor scanned and said it must be done tomorrow itself.
Then that doctor called a senior doctor and said, “Doctor, can you please check once more? We have booked the procedure for tomorrow.”
The senior doctor checked and said, “There is no problem at all. This doesn’t need to be done.” Immediately she called me and told me.
I said, “Didn’t I tell you? I am talking to the biggest doctor! Then why are you afraid?” Just like a Pilgrim Mother,
our Heavenly Mother was with her throughout.
Later, they took the date for delivery — a C-section was booked. One day before the C-section, the baby’s weight was only 1900 grams.
The doctor said, “Let’s wait a little more. The baby needs a little more weight.” At that time there was no problem.
The next day her BP increased. Because her BP went up, the doctor said the surgery must be done immediately.
At that time, I was at my hometown. I applied Covenant oil on her stomach and prayed, “Mother, we need at least 200 grams more.”
I told them also, “We need 200 more grams,” and prayed — “Mother doesn’t need even a minute to increase the baby’s weight.”
They took her for scanning again and the next day booked the C-section. Because of her BP, they took her inside early for the surgery.
I stood in front of the operation theatre and prayed the Apparition Prayer 33 times.
When the baby was born, his weight had become 2.1 kg. I couldn’t even handle the joy — in just one day, from 1.9kg grams to 2.1 kg!
The doctors said the baby didn’t need to be put in the NICU — just feed him a little and there is no other issue. They brought the baby back.
If this baby gets any fever or anything, I apply Covenant oil — I am the one who applies it for her.
And that is this child! On November 30, he will turn one year old.
After that, I had unbearable tooth pain. I work in Saudi Arabia. The doctor took an X-ray and said there is a lot of decay — two teeth must be removed.
I said, “I won’t get any leave now. Not even sick leave. The doctors there won’t give leave.” Due to the infection,
I couldn’t even open my mouth or eat food. I told Mother, “I have taken the Covenant,
right? Take care of me. You are with me in everything!”
The next day when I checked… I used to rinse with Mother’s blessed salt mixed in hot water every day.
After two days, I told the doctor, “Doctor, please check once more.” The doctor checked and said,
“Now there is no problem. No need to remove the tooth.” From that, I was able to return to duty without removing the tooth — and there the doctors won’t even give sick leave.
No matter how much pain we have, we must go to work.
After that, I couldn’t even lift my hand. Because of a nerve issue, I needed my colleagues’ help just to wear my dress.
I applied Covenant oil and salt, and rinsed with hot salt water. Within two or three days, I didn’t even know where that hand pain disappeared.
My Mother — Kreupasanam Mother — has blessed me so much, and made me stand as a living testimony here.
I thank her with all my heart.
A big thanks to Jesus, to the Holy Mother of God, and to the Holy Spirit.
A big thanks to Jesus and Kreupasanam Mother.
Thank you, Ave Maria. As an act of mercy, I would help at our orphanage and old age home there. I help them however I can.
In the beginning, I was very lazy to help others. But now, if I am unable to help, that itself hurts me.
I realized the needs of others and I started wanting to help — and when I help someone, my heart is filled with joy.
If it is the leaflet, I will give it to whoever needs it. Through one leaflet, what
blessings happened in my life — it was through that leaflet that I came to know Kreupasanam.
It is Mother’s hand. Mother will call those who must come here — and at the right time, she will bring them here. She has done so many blessings.
For those who struggle even for food, if I can help, I feel so grateful. Every day, during Holy Mass… God blessed me with the grace to listen to Mass and to pray the Rosary.
Normally, whenever I prayed, I used to fall asleep — but after coming through the Covenant,
I understood what God’s love is. I also came to know and love my Mother deeply,
and through Mother, I came to know who Jesus truly is. I received that blessing after coming here, and I thank God for it. Ave Maria… Thank you Jesus very much.
Psalm 86:5-7 — “O Lord, you are good and forgiving.”
“You show abundant mercy to all who call upon You.” “Lord,
hear my prayer; listen to my cry for mercy. In my day of trouble I call to You, and You answer me.” This sister,
Jino Joseph, is joyfully testifying at this altar how her great intention,
submitted at Mother’s feet for her family — was miraculously fulfilled through Mother’s powerful intervention.
Father Joseph always tells us: “Not by Merit but by the grace of God.” When the merits of our life are exhausted — always remember — the power of God has not ended!
The works of the living God have not reduced in any way!
When we call upon Him, He will stay with us — and He will touch our lives so that we may witness His glory.
Through this child, this family is experiencing a wonderful testimony and divine intervention. Let us pray that God’s power flows over every area of our lives —
and with gratitude to Mother and Jesus for this baby — let us clap our hands and offer this testimony.
